title: Where Both Halves Dream They Are Whole Again

features.name: the split dwelling
features.desc-on-touch: Two shopfronts face each other across a dead channel. Each contains a mirror-path of the other. In sleep they drift together.

features.name: the counterpart
features.desc-on-touch: Its twin, reversed and waiting. They have never touched waking.

features.name: the reaching current
features.desc-on-touch: Between them: the only thing that moves, the only thing that remembers both sides.

inscription: fracture and dreaming are not opposites; they are neighbours learning each other's shapes

file.name: Surgery_Broadcast_Twin_Stations.mp3
file.note: A radio drama of one surgical procedure narrated from two simultaneously-transmitting local stations in different dialects. Both true. Both whole.
